title: Privacy Policy
content:
# Privacy Policy for EWM (Exercise With Me)
**Last Updated: September 7, 2026**   **Effective Date: September 7, 2026**   **Application:** EWM (Exercise With Me)
---
## 1. Introduction
Welcome to **EWM (Exercise With Me)** ("we," "our," "us," or the "App"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and related services (collectively, the "Service").
By accessing or using EWM, you consent to the data collection and usage practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, please do not use the App.
---
## 2. Information We Collect
We collect information that identifies, relates to, or could reasonably be linked with you ("Personal Information"). The categories of information we collect include:
### A. Information You Provide Directly to Us - **Account Credentials:** Full name, email address, password, date of birth (to verify that you meet the minimum age requirement of 18+), and gender. - **Profile Details:** Profile photo, fitness bio, workout preferences, fitness level, preferred sports/activities, and emergency contact details (optional). - **Third-Party Authentication (Google Sign-In / Firebase Auth):** When you choose to register or log in using Google Sign-In, we receive your verified email address, name, profile image, and Google user ID as permitted by your Google account settings. - **Communications & User Content:** Messages, chats, and event postings you send or participate in via real-time chat (Socket.io) or community boards.
### B. Information Collected Automatically - **Location Data (Crucial Feature):** With your explicit permission, we collect precise and/or approximate location data (`ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION` and `ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`) to show nearby workout buddies, local exercise events, and fitness activities within your vicinity (e.g., up to a 10-mile radius). - **Device & Usage Data:** Device model, operating system version, unique device identifiers, IP address, network carrier, crash logs, and app performance diagnostics.
### C. Financial and Payment Information - **In-App Purchases & Subscriptions:** Payments for premium subscriptions and memberships are processed through **Apple App Store**, **Google Play Store**, **Stripe**, and **RevenueCat**. We do not store or process your full credit card numbers or banking credentials directly on our servers. All transactions are securely handled by certified payment gateways in compliance with PCI-DSS standards.
---
## 3. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected information for the following purposes: 1. **Provide and Maintain the Service:** Creating and managing user accounts, authenticating logins, and hosting your public fitness profile. 2. **Location-Based Matching:** Connecting you with exercise partners and community fitness events based on geographical proximity. 3. **Communication:** Facilitating in-app chat and coordination between workout partners. 4. **Subscription Management:** Processing premium features, subscription renewals, and purchase history through RevenueCat and Stripe. 5. **Safety and Verification:** Enforcing our age gate (18+ policy), monitoring against fraudulent accounts, preventing harassment, and maintaining community standards. 6. **Customer Support & Improvements:** Diagnosing bugs, optimizing UI/UX performance, and responding to user inquiries. 7. **Legal Compliance:** Complying with applicable laws, legal requests, and law enforcement directives.
---
## 4. How Your Information Is Shared
We will **never sell or rent** your personal data to third-party data brokers or advertisers. We share information only in the following limited circumstances:
1. **Other EWM Users:** Your public profile (display name, profile photo, bio, workout preferences, and approximate distance) is visible to other registered users to enable partner discovery. Your exact street address or real-time GPS coordinates are never displayed to other users. 2. **Service Providers & Subprocessors:** We partner with trusted third-party providers to operate our infrastructure:    - **Google Cloud & Firebase:** Authentication, real-time database, and cloud hosting.    - **Google Maps API:** Geolocation display and mapping services.    - **RevenueCat & Stripe:** In-app subscription status and payment processing.    - **Socket.io Servers:** Real-time messaging infrastructure. 3. **Legal Obligations:** If required to do so by court order, subpoena, or governmental regulation, or if we believe disclosure is necessary to protect the safety of users or the public. 4. **Business Transfers:** In connection with any merger, sale of company assets, or acquisition, subject to the acquiring party honoring this Privacy Policy.
---
## 5. Location Information & Permissions
EWM relies on location data to function as an exercise partner discovery platform: - **Permission Requests:** We request permission to access your device's location (`ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION` and `ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`) when using features that search for nearby workout buddies. - **Controlling Location Access:** You may grant or revoke location access at any time through your device settings (`Settings > Apps > EWM > Permissions > Location`). Revoking location access may limit your ability to find nearby fitness partners.
---
## 6. Data Retention and Account Deletion
We retain your personal information for as long as your account remains active or as needed to provide you with the Service: - **Account Deletion:** You have the right to request the permanent deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time. You can initiate account deletion directly within the App under `Profile > Settings > Delete Account` or by contacting our privacy team at `support@exercisewithme.com`. - Upon confirmed deletion, your profile, photos, chat history, and location associations will be permanently removed from our active databases within 30 days, except where retention is legally required.
---
## 7. Security of Your Information
We implement industry-standard technical, physical, and administrative security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include HTTPS/TLS encryption for all in-transit communications, hashed password storage, and secure token-based API authentication. However, no internet transmission or electronic storage method is 100% immune to security breaches.
---
## 8. Age Policy (Minors Prohibited)
EWM is strictly intended for individuals who are **18 years of age or older**. We do not knowingly solicit or collect information from children under 18. An age-verification gate is enforced during registration. If we discover that personal information from an individual under 18 has been collected, we will immediately terminate the account and purge the data.
---
## 9. Your Privacy Rights (GDPR, CCPA & International Rights)
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights: - **Access & Portability:** Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. - **Correction / Rectification:** Update inaccurate or incomplete profile information. - **Deletion (Right to be Forgotten):** Request that we erase your personal data. - **Opt-Out of Non-Essential Processing:** Restrict or object to certain types of data processing. - **Non-Discrimination:** We will not discriminate against you for exercising your legal privacy rights.
To exercise any of these rights, email us at `support@exercisewithme.com`.
---
## 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When changes are made, we will revise the "Last Updated" date at the top of this document. For material updates, we will notify you through in-app notices or via email before the changes take effect. Continued use of the App following notification constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
---
## 11. Contact Us
If you have questions, comments, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
- **App Name:** EWM (Exercise With Me) - **Email:** `support@exercisewithme.com` - **Developer Organization:** FitBuddy / EWM Team

You may not use, copy, or redistribute our IP without prior written authorization.
